parameters.name: RecordList
parameters.description: The list of DNS records to create.

sub_parameters.name: AuthConf
sub_parameters.description: The origin authentication information of the CNAME record.

sub_parameters.name: BizName
sub_parameters.description:
The business scenario for record acceleration. Valid values:
- **image_video**: video and image.
- **api**: API.
- **web**: web page.

sub_parameters.name: Data
sub_parameters.description: The DNS information of the record. Different fields are required based on the record type.

sub_parameters.name: Proxied
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable proxied acceleration for the record. Only CNAME records and A/AAAA records support proxied acceleration. Valid values:
- **true**: Proxied acceleration is enabled.
- **false**: Proxied acceleration is disabled.

sub_parameters.name: SourceType
sub_parameters.description:
The origin type of the CNAME record. This parameter is required when you add a CNAME record. Valid values:

- **OSS**: OSS origin.
- **S3**: S3 origin.
- **LB**: load balancing origin.
- **OP**: IPAM pool origin.
- **Domain**: common domain name origin.

If this parameter is left empty or not specified, the default value is Domain, which indicates a common domain name origin.

sub_parameters.name: Ttl
sub_parameters.description: The time-to-live (TTL) of the record, in seconds. A value of 1 indicates that the TTL is set to automatic.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description: The DNS type of the record.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.
